name: portfolio-terminal
description: Portfólio dark minimalista com interface de terminal interativo

scripts.smoke: vite build --ssr scripts/smoke.ts --outDir node_modules/.smoke --logLevel error && node node_modules/.smoke/smoke.js
scripts.render-check: vite build --ssr scripts/render.ts --outDir node_modules/.smoke --logLevel error && node node_modules/.smoke/render.js
scripts.test: npm run smoke && npm run render-check
